dataset_name: UCI Default of Credit Card Clients
dataset_citation: Yeh, I. C., & Lien, C. H. (2009). The comparisons of data mining techniques for the predictive accuracy of probability of default of credit card clients. Expert Systems with Applications, 36(2), 2473-2480.
target_variable: default (0 = Non-default next month, 1 = Default next month)
selection_rationale: XGBoost selected based on superior ROC-AUC and balanced recall under class-weighted loss, while Random Forest is retained as benchmark.
dataset_limitations: The UCI Credit Card Default dataset represents revolving consumer credit card customers in Taiwan (April-September 2005). It captures historical billing and repayment delay trends, but does not contain real-time Indian UPI transaction telemetry, bank statement salary credits, or GST filings. In SpendiFy, this ML model scores behavioral credit risk from repayment track records, while monthly income, living expenses, and liquid surplus are deterministically evaluated by the SpendiFy Affordability Engine.
